'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**An [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[suicide bombing|suicide bomber]] blows himself up at a tea shop near a [[Somali Armed Forces|military base]] in [[Mogadishu]], killing six soldiers and three civilians and injuring 11 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/14/several-civilians-and-soldiers-killed-in-mogadishu-suicide-attack (Al Jazeera)]
*Aftermath of the [[assassination of Jovenel Moïse]]
**Prosecutor Bed-Ford Claude asks a judge to forbid prime minister [[Ariel Henry]] from leaving Haiti "by air, sea or road" due to "serious presumption relative to the assassination of the former president". [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/haiti-chief-prosecutor-calls-pm-be-charged-presidents-killing-2021-09-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Seven people are killed when a [[Beechcraft Super King Air#King Air 360 and 360ER|King Air 360]] crashed shortly after takeoff in [[Piracicaba]], [[Brazil]]. Among the victims is the Brazilian [[Energy industry|energy company]] [[Cosan]] shareholder Celso Silveira Mello Filho and his family. [https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/brazilian-energy-company-cosan-says-shareholder-died-in-plane-crash-2021-09-14 (Nasdaq)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] surpasses 130,000 [[COVID-19]]-related deaths. [https://www.ilmessaggero.it/salute/focus/covid_bollettino_italia_oggi_14_settembre_morti_contagi_ricoveri-6195454.html (Il Messaggero)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****Caretaker [[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] announces that the {{cvt|1.5|m}} [[social distancing]] requirement will be lifted on September 25 and instead, a "[[Immunity passport#COVID-19 vaccination certificates|Corona pass]]" will be required in order to enter bars, restaurants, and large-scale events and festivals as the number of COVID-19 cases declines. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-09-dutch-covid-social-distancing.html (MedicalXpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] enters self-isolation after several members of his inner circle tested positive for COVID-19. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-vladimir-putin-isolation-coronavirus-pandemic-f842e18bbb1bcb7090aa84de9b42951e (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] surpasses two million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysia-passes-2-million-mark-for-covid-19-cases-as-it-prepares-to-reopen-the-economy (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Singapore]]
*****[[Singapore]] begins a nationwide campaign to administer [[booster dose]]s of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] for people over the age of 60 and people with a [[immunocompromise|compromised immune system]] who received their second dose at least six months ago amid an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Spotlight/Coronavirus/COVID-vaccines/Singapore-starts-booster-shots-as-COVID-cases-hit-1-year-high (''Nikkei Asia'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Sudan]]
****[[South Sudan]] receives its first shipment of 152,950 doses of the single-dose [[Janssen COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://m.guardian.ng/apo-press-releases/coronavirus-south-sudan-receives-its-first-consignment-of-johnson-johnson-covid-19-vaccines-through-the-covax-facility/ (APO Group via ''The Guardian Nigeria'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe]]
****The [[Parliament of Zimbabwe]] bans anyone who is [[COVID-19 vaccination in Zimbabwe|unvaccinated]] against COVID-19 from attending church service in order to increase the vaccination rate. [https://www.barrons.com/news/zimbabwe-imposes-covid-vaccine-on-churchgoers-01631649309?refsec=afp-news (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Dolphin drive hunting]]	
**More than 1,400 [[atlantic white-sided dolphin]]s are killed during hunting in the [[Faroe Islands]], the biggest ever slaughter in the history of the annual hunt known as the ''Grindadráp''. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2021/sep/14/outcry-over-killing-of-almost-1500-dolphins-on-faroe-islands (''The Guardian'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[LGBT rights in Hungary]], [[LGBT rights in Poland]]
**At the end of a [[European Union]] summit, representatives threaten to fine [[Poland]] on a daily basis and withhold part of the EU's budget from [[Hungary]] over their laws against the gay and [[LGBT community|LGBT communities]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-09-14/lgbtq-rights-eu-s-battle-with-hungary-and-poland-could-transform-the-bloc?srnd=equality (Bloomberg)]
*[[China–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[List of ambassadors of China to the United Kingdom|Chinese ambassador]] [[Zheng Zeguang]] is banned from entering the [[Palace of Westminster|Parliament of the United Kingdom]] while sanctions remain in place on a number of British MPs and officials. Zheng was due to attend a Commons reception on Wednesday. [[China]] says that this was a "despicable and cowardly" decision. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-58556460 (BBC News)]
*[[France–Mali relations]], [[Mali–Russia relations]]
**[[France]] says that a planned deal between [[Mali]]'s [[military junta]] led by [[Assimi Goïta]] and the [[Wagner Group]] to bring [[Russia]]n [[Private military company|private military contractors]] into Mali was "incompatible" with the current [[French Armed Forces|French military]] presence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/france-criticises-deal-bringing-russian-mercenaries-into-mali-2021-09-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[North Korea]] demonstrates two [[short-range ballistic missile]]s that land just outside [[Japan]]'s territorial waters and then only hours later [[South Korea]] demonstrates a [[submarine-launched ballistic missile]]. Comments made during the South Korean launch immediately draw condemning remarks from North Korea's [[Kim Yo-jong]]. [https://apnews.com/article/seoul-south-korea-north-korea-pyongyang-1bf74218556e36697983cf6669ec9166 (AP)]
*Continuing his apostolic journey, [[Pope Francis]] arrives in [[Slovakia]], meeting with President [[Zuzana Čaputová]] who were joined by civil leaders, members of the diplomatic corps and religious leaders. After a meeting with the Jewish community, the Pope went to the apostolic nunciature, where he met with the Speaker of the National Council (parliament), [[Boris Kollár]], and with Prime Minister [[Eduard Heger]]. [https://www.catholicculture.org/news/headlines/index.cfm?storyid=52204 (Catholic World News)]

*[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Arizona]]
***[[Arizona Attorney General]] [[Mark Brnovich]] files a lawsuit against [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] and [[Presidency of Joe Biden|his administration]] over the vaccine mandate. [https://ktar.com/story/4682347/arizona-ag-mark-brnovich-sues-president-joe-biden-over-covid-19-vaccine-plan/amp/ (KTAR)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**A [[Judiciary of Mexico|Mexican court]] sentences [[Vicente Carrillo Fuentes]], a former leader of the [[Juárez Cartel|Juárez]] [[drug cartel]], to 28 years in prison on the charges of [[organized crime]] and [[drug trafficking]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/mexican-ex-cartel-boss-jailed-for-28-years (AFP via RFI)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 United States gubernatorial elections]]
**[[2021 California gubernatorial recall election]]
***[[California]] voters head to the polls to determine whether to remove or keep incumbent [[Governor of California|Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]]. This will be the first gubernatorial recall election in California since [[2003 California gubernatorial recall election|2003]]. [https://apnews.com/article/joe-biden-donald-trump-california-climate-elections-a590782877be099d44f1766b2d138394 (AP)]
***[[Governor of California|Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] survives the [[recall election]], making him the second governor to survive a recall after former [[Governor of Wisconsin|Wisconsin Governor]] [[Scott Walker (politician)|Scott Walker]] in [[2012 Wisconsin gubernatorial recall election|2012]]. [https://www.businessinsider.com/california-governor-gavin-newsom-recall-election-live-results-2021-9 (''Business Insider'')]
